title: Data Cards: Purposeful and Transparent Dataset Documentation for Responsible AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model fairness by annotating bounding boxes in computer vision datasets with 'perceived gender presentation' attributes, and assessing language translation models for gender accuracy and anaphora resolution errors using biographies containing gender-indicative terms.
Annotating computer vision datasets with 'perceived age range presentation' (e.g., young, middle, older) to assess and mitigate bias in model performance across different age demographics.

Curating geographically diverse datasets (e.g., Wikipedia biographies sampled across various countries and continents) to evaluate whether language models make demographic assumptions based on names uncommon in American/English contexts.
